takeaway: Varicocele: a 'bag of worms' felt only on standing. More common on the left, as the left testicular vein drains into the left renal vein; the right drains directly into the IVC.

lines.text: A thirty-two-year-old man complains of a dragging sensation in his left scrotum.
The doctor feels a soft mass, like a bag of worms,
but only when the patient is standing.
This is the classic description of a varicocele.
Varicoceles are more common on the left, because the left testicular vein drains into the left renal vein,
whereas the right testicular vein drains directly into the IVC.
lines.say: whereas the right testicular vein drains directly into the I V C.
